A student who arrives more than 10 minutes after the class starts is marked absent for that
class.

can get condonation at most twice during the whole degree. Below 65 percent, condonation is
not possible and the course must be repeated.

Ragging is not tolerated. A student found ragging is suspended immediately and the case
goes to the Anti-Ragging Committee in Block A, room 12.
Smoking or drinking alcohol on campus or in the hostel is fined Rs 5,000 for the first offence
and Rs 10,000 for the second offence. After a third offence, the student is suspended for one
semester.
Lab coats and closed shoes are compulsory in laboratories. Mobile phones must be on silent
in classes and can be used only with the teacher's permission.
Fines must be paid at the accounts office within 7 days. A student with unpaid fines does not
get the hall ticket.

acknowledgement within 2 working days, and the grievance is resolved within 15 working
days. A student who is not satisfied can appeal to the Dean of Students within 7 days. A final
appeal can be made to the Director within 7 days of the Dean's decision.

8. Transport, ID cards and campus services
The college bus service runs on 6 city routes. The bus pass costs Rs 6,000 per semester. A
pass that is renewed after 15 August carries a late fee of Rs 200. A pass surrendered within
the first 30 days is refunded on a pro-rata basis.
Morning buses reach the campus by 8:45 am. Evening buses leave the campus at 5:00 pm
and at 6:30 pm.
The first student ID card is free. A replacement ID card costs Rs 200, takes 3 working days
and is applied for at the administration office. Entry to the campus is not allowed without the ID
card.
Campus Wi-Fi gives each student 50 GB of fast data per month at up to 200 Mbps. After 50
GB the speed is reduced to 2 Mbps, and the connection is not blocked.

extension is 301. Every student is covered by an accident insurance of Rs 2,00,000 per year,
which is included in the tuition fee. Insurance claims must be filed within 15 days.
